envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: claude has one global status line and no per-agent key; the gloss's 'nothing asks at runtime' needs its claude form

payload.gloss: the running persona's name and mark emoji shown in the harness status line so the operator sees which persona a session runs; projected from the agent cell into that persona's own launch scope, so placement names the persona and nothing asks at runtime; shown only in the top-level interactive session, never a subagent's; its own module, apart from guardrails and session hooks; carries no hue where the harness strips color (omp strips it from extension status text) On Claude Code the status line is one host-owned command with no segments: install sets a badge status line only where the host has none, and otherwise offers to wrap the host's command, never replacing it. On Claude Code, placement still decides which personas have a badge, and the harness's own status-line input names the persona running (agent.name); the status line asks nothing else.
